raw_text: Integrate modes and genres most appropriate to purpose and audience. (I/C)
competency_statement: Use different ways and types of communication that best fit the purpose and audience when presenting.
observable_behaviors: Choose communication modes (such as speaking, drawing, or using digital media) that suit the audience and purpose.
Select genres (such as stories, reports, or explanations) appropriate for the presentation context.
Combine multiple modes or genres effectively to share information with others.
skill_clauses: Integrate modes of communication appropriate to the purpose and audience.
Integrate genres appropriate to the purpose and audience.

student_actions.oral_production: Use appropriate modes and genres to communicate for a specific audience and purpose.
student_actions.procedural_application: Integrate different communication modes and genres to tailor presentations to the audience and purpose.
student_actions.reasoning_explanation: Explain why certain modes and genres are chosen to fit the audience and purpose.
